name: Advanced Bodyweight
description: Four workouts a week for 10 weeks with a pull-up bar and floor space, for someone who already does ten pull-ups and twenty push-ups. Harder versions take the place of weight: archer and handstand push-ups, commando and neutral-grip pull-ups, pistol and shrimp squats, Nordic curls, toes to bar and hollow rocks, with one day of jumps and core. Four weeks of volume, a lighter week, then five weeks of the hardest versions with fewer reps and slower lowering. Meant to be done as written.

phases.name: Volume
phases.description: Four sets on the main movements, stopping two reps before failure

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.notes: Control the way down; push off the floor to come up

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: two sets of everything, so you start the next phase recovered

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.notes: Control the way down; push off the floor to come up

phases.name: Hardest Versions
phases.description: Handstand push-ups, shrimp squats, slow pull-ups and five sets on the main movements

exercises.notes: Against a wall; pike push-ups with the feet raised if you cannot do four

exercises.name: Pull-Up
